title: Geometry optimization at B3PW91*/TZV
action: Perform full geometry optimization of singlet ¹[Fe(CO)₄], triplet ³[Fe(CO)₄], [Fe(CO)₅], and CO at the B3PW91*/TZV level.
description: Generate equilibrium structures used for subsequent frequency and coupled‑cluster calculations.

title: Harmonic frequency calculation at B3PW91*/TZV
action: Compute harmonic vibrational frequencies at the optimized geometries to obtain zero‑point energy corrections.
description: Obtain ZPE values needed for the final energetics.

title: BP86/TZV orbital calculation
action: Run a single‑point BP86/TZV calculation at the optimized geometries and store the resulting Kohn–Sham orbitals for use as reference orbitals in CCSD(T).
description: Generate BP86 DFT orbitals that reduce the τ₁ diagnostic and improve CCSD(T) applicability.

title: CCSD(T)/VQZ-VDZ energy calculation
action: Perform CCSD(T) single‑point calculations using the VQZ‑VDZ basis set and the BP86 orbitals from step_03 for each species.
description: Compute high‑level total electronic energies following the paper’s recommended protocol.

title: Collect scored energetics into energies.csv
action: Extract the CCSD(T)/VQZ‑VDZ total electronic energies and the B3PW91* ZPEs for all four species. Write a CSV with columns: species, CCSD(T)/VQZ-VDZ_total_energy_Hartree, B3PW91*_zero_point_energy_Hartree.
description: Compilation of the computed energies from which the checker will derive ΔE(1,3) and BDE(3).
output_schema: CSV with columns: species, CCSD(T)/VQZ-VDZ_total_energy_Hartree, B3PW91*_zero_point_energy_Hartree. Species values: singlet_FeCO4, triplet_FeCO4, FeCO5, CO. All energies in Hartree.
